entry: next official market-session opening price; no deferred fill
model_source: current eight financial-input C models, November 4 metadata, exact OOF SHA256 match required
maturity: purge until actual company-bar 20-day labels of every reconstructed training-key superset have matured, including rolling decision-day keys; HPO maturity also audited
selection: maximize development mean net return minus one standard error of signal-date means; deterministic ties by name; freeze before computing holdout metrics
intraday_order_primary: stop first, except observed opening gaps
trailing_stop: previous close high-water mark; activation from next session
upside_estimator: equal-weight nearest neighbors in six frozen class percentiles and two within-pool rank percentiles, training cohort base95, matured before prediction month; K in 50,100,200 selected on development MFE mean squared error; compare expanding cohort mean
forecast_timing: choose day 1..20 maximizing neighbors mean closing return, fixed before entry; compare same-neighbor constant cohort timing and fixed day20
reporting: trade-weighted independent signals, top2 each day, no capital compounding; additional three-slot diagnostic if feasible
known_limitations: C features were selected after viewing parts of this historical period in previous experiments; this is exploratory, not fresh future confirmation
OOF hyperparameters were tuned using pre-September-2025 data, which is fit/reference only, not evaluated as untouched data
exact current mart unavailable via artifact download; frozen previous mart plus all current OOF keys forms a conservative reconstructed key audit, not proof of complete input parity
daily bars do not prove executable liquidity, market/limit availability, or intraday order; no dividends, taxes, borrow, market impact or actual order book
